name: Bug report

## Component and revision

Which component or payload are you using, and from which source commit?

## Reproduction

Provide the smallest useful example: the selected files, relevant filled values, steps or commands,
and any host or tool versions needed to reproduce it. Omit credentials and other private values.

## Expected and actual behavior

What should happen, and what happened instead? Include relevant error output or rendered text.
